user_query: How many labeled edge examples did node2vec use for link prediction on the Facebook network after removing half of its edges, and what was the final train-test split?
llm_response: In the Facebook link-prediction experiment, node2vec used 1,000 labeled edge examples in total after removing half of the network’s edges, with a final 50/50 train-test split (500 training and 500 test examples).
llm_confidence_reasoning: This matches the commonly reported node2vec Facebook link-prediction setup, but the exact wording can vary across summaries of the paper.
